title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Clarkson University
description: Discover the essential late-night food stops for Clarkson University students in Potsdam, from on-campus 'Late Knight' dining to local pizzerias and 24-hour convenience hubs.

cards.title: Late Knight at the Servery
cards.subtitle: On-Campus Dining Hub
cards.notes: Head to the second floor for 'Late Knight' service until 11:30 PM. It is the primary campus spot for late-night tacos, burgers, and breakfast bars during the semester.
cards.short_summary: The central on-campus dining location offering dedicated late-night meal service for students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Center Servery offers 'Late Knight' dining from 8:30 PM to 11:30 PM, Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Open until 11:30 PM daily during the academic year; accepts meal plans and Knight Cards.

cards.title: The Famous Pizza Roll Run
cards.subtitle: Downtown Potsdam Staple
cards.notes: Visit this local landmark for their signature deep-fried pizza rolls. It is a long-standing tradition for students heading into downtown Potsdam.
cards.short_summary: A historic downtown pizzeria famous among Clarkson students for its unique deep-fried pizza rolls.
cards.evidence_claim: Sergi's Italian Restaurant has been a family tradition in Potsdam since 1967, serving signature pizza rolls and Italian dishes.
cards.access_notes: Located downtown; check seasonal hours for late-night weekend service.

cards.title: Ice Cream and Snacks at Stewart's
cards.subtitle: Maple Street Convenience
cards.notes: Stop by for a late-night scoop of Philly Vanilla or a quick snack. This regional favorite is a reliable stop for students living near the hill campus.
cards.short_summary: A regional convenience store chain known for its local milk, ice cream, and quick hot food options.
cards.evidence_claim: Stewart's Shops at 26 Maple Street provides convenience items, snacks, and an ice cream counter for the Potsdam community.
cards.source_title: Convenience Store and Gas Station in Potsdam, 13676 | Stewart's Shops - 370
cards.access_notes: Open daily with late hours; features a walk-in ice cream counter.

cards.title: Late Night Slices at Little Italy
cards.subtitle: Market Street Pizzeria
cards.notes: Grab a slice or a 'Sandstoner' sub at this downtown spot. It is a frequent destination for students seeking classic New York-style pizza late into the evening.
cards.short_summary: A popular downtown pizzeria offering New York-style slices and specialty sandwiches.
cards.evidence_claim: Little Italy on Market Street is open until 10:00 PM on Fridays and Saturdays, serving pizza by the slice.
cards.source_title: Contact Us - Little Italy Potsdam NY
cards.access_notes: Open until 10 PM on weekends; offers delivery within the village.

cards.title: The Market Street Taco Run
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Fast Food
cards.notes: A standard late-night destination on Market Street for burritos and tacos. It remains one of the few consistent late-night drive-thru options in the village.
cards.short_summary: A reliable fast-food chain location on the main commercial strip in Potsdam.
cards.evidence_claim: The Taco Bell at 153 Market Street serves the Potsdam area with late-night dining hours.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell® in Potsdam, NY - 153 Market Street
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru typically open later than dining room; check app for current closing times.

cards.title: Midnight Golden Arches
cards.subtitle: 24-Hour Drive-Thru
cards.notes: Located further down Market Street, this is the go-to for 24-hour service when everything else in town has closed for the night.
cards.short_summary: The primary 24-hour food option in Potsdam, located on the northern end of Market Street.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald's in Potsdam at 171 Market Street offers 24-hour drive-thru service for late-night needs.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is open 24 hours; dining room hours are more limited.

cards.title: The 24/7 Market Street Hub
cards.subtitle: All-Night Convenience
cards.notes: Grab a Slurpee or hot snacks at any hour. This location serves as a critical 24/7 resource for students pulling all-nighters or returning late to campus.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour convenience store providing snacks, drinks, and basic groceries on Market Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The 7-Eleven at 147 Market Street is a 24-hour convenience store serving the Potsdam area.
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

cards.title: Dinner at RoBro
cards.subtitle: Main Campus Eatery
cards.notes: While it closes earlier than the Servery, RoBro is the heart of campus dining. Check for special late-night themed events like 'Late Knight Breakfast' during finals.
cards.short_summary: The main all-you-care-to-eat dining hall on the Clarkson hill campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Ross-Brooks (RoBro) is the resident dining hall on campus, offering rotating menus and special dining events.
cards.source_title: Dining on Campus & Catering | Clarkson University
cards.access_notes: Regular dinner service ends at 8:30 PM; check for special late-night event announcements.

cards.title: Coffee Runs on Maple
cards.subtitle: Early and Late Caffeine
cards.notes: Located in the Mountain Mart, this is the primary spot for a late-afternoon or early-evening caffeine boost before a long study session.
cards.short_summary: The sole remaining Dunkin' location in Potsdam, providing coffee and baked goods.
cards.evidence_claim: The Dunkin' at 119 Maple Street is located within the Mountain Mart and serves the Potsdam community.
cards.source_title: Dunkin' at 119 Maple St in Potsdam | Coffee & Donuts Near You
cards.access_notes: Open until 8:00 PM daily; convenient for students on the eastern side of campus.

cards.title: Riverside Dining at Jake's
cards.subtitle: Hannawa Falls Destination
cards.notes: A short drive from campus, this spot offers brick-oven pizza and a scenic view of the Raquette River. It's a popular choice for a more relaxed evening meal.
cards.short_summary: A waterfront restaurant near Potsdam known for its contemporary cuisine and scenic views.
cards.evidence_claim: Jake's on the Water is located in Hannawa Falls and offers brick oven pizza and contemporary dining.
cards.access_notes: Located about 10 minutes from campus; check seasonal hours for evening service.
